title: The service path identity, measured rather than assumed

role_assignments._run_id_disambiguation: /claude/r0_steward (Anthropic) is THIS package's Integration Owner and must record its own capability declaration before this package leaves backlog. /root/r0_steward (OpenAI Codex) is a DIFFERENT run: it is the Integration Owner of WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 and is named in open_blockers solely because it must countersign the amendments made to those two packages and record the WP-0A-CON-001 npm run check addendum. Neither run substitutes for the other. Independent testing flagged the near-identical names as ambiguous; both are intended.

independence.cross_vendor_exception: prefer_cross_vendor_review is NOT satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register (§ cross-vendor review) permits this only as an explicit exception - 'if there is no cross-vendor capacity, use an independent agent per run and record the exception'. Each of the five roles is a separate agent run with its own capability declaration and no run reviewed, tested, or integrated its own work. The Integration Owner must carry this exception forward; it is not waived and it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review.

required_human_authorities: Product Owner disposition of RFC-2026-017, which closes the half of DATA-DEC-03 RFC-2026-016 left open.
A1 to countersign the role topology before the roles are created, since DATA-DEC-03 is owned A0+A1 and this is a security surface.
purpose: RFC-2026-016 closed the direction of DATA-DEC-03 and refused to claim the control, because the service path was undecided and on Supabase the service-role key bypasses RLS. The instance was then measured: service_role bypasses, and so does postgres, which is the role in every direct connection string -- so both obvious options bypass. postgres holds rolcreaterole, so a topology that does not bypass is implementable. This package records the decision that follows, which closes the half of DATA-DEC-03 that was left open.

include: RFC-2026-017 recording the service-path decision and the role topology it implies
The measurement behind it, taken from the provisioned instance rather than vendor documentation
The costs of the decision, recorded so they are not discovered later as surprises
exclude: Creating the roles. That is a migration, and it belongs to the batch A0 owns, not to a decision record.
Writing any tenant table or policy. Batch 010 is A1 Identity's.
Claiming the isolation is proven. No tenant table exists, so no cross-tenant assertion has run.
Disposing this RFC. That is the Product Owner's act on a disposition branch.

amends_without_owning.rationale: The four registries that must move when a branch or a decision record is added, and which exist so that adding one is a deliberate act in a diff. RFC-2026-017 joins the protected-file list and the pinned decision-record set, and is digested; this branch joins the branch-to-package mapping. No floor is lowered and no existing row is changed.

acceptance_criteria: The RFC states the measurement it rests on, names the instance it was taken from, and does not cite vendor documentation in its place.
It records that postgres bypasses RLS as well as service_role, so that a reader does not conclude a direct driver is by itself a fix.
The role topology names every role, its purpose, and that none holds BYPASSRLS.
The costs are recorded in the RFC, not left to be discovered during implementation.
The RFC does NOT claim tenant isolation is proven, and names the assertion that would prove it as still owed.
The RFC is committed with status Proposed.
required_tests: The work-package and ownership validators accept this manifest
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. RFC-2026-017 is a Proposed decision record: no role is created, no policy written, no migration applied, and nothing on the provisioned instance is touched by it.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-017 is Proposed. No role is created and no policy is written until it is disposed.

Tenant isolation is NOT proven. No tenant table exists, so DB00-A03 and the smoke assertions have never run, and the data package's own smoke set would not detect a regression in this decision: every assertion runs as a client role and one asserts only that the server helper succeeds.

The negative assertion that WOULD detect it -- the service identity denied an operation the matrix marks N for service, with an error rather than an empty result -- does not exist and is owed by whoever writes the first tenant table.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; a Proposed decision record is reversible, synthetic-only work.
